notes.title: SURPRISE! CLASH: BLUE MIRAGE IS OUT OF EARLY ACCESS!!!!
notes.content:
Yes, that is pretty much it.  The game is out.  Go buy it or whatever.  I'm done.

(Unless you guys find bugs that I missed and report them in the Steam forums and I see the bug report, I will then take time to fix it.  But nothing big.  I am retiring from visual novel writing because I just want to write, I don't want to do all the extra stuff anymore.  :-) )

Game is released because idk, it is now $4.99 because idk, and Clash: Robot Detective is also now $4.99 because idk.

Enjoy!

notes.title: February Hype Update (RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT!!)
notes.content:
So the bad news is, I've been having to take work home with me all last week and the next two weeks.  That eats into devtime, which has - yet AGAIN - slowed down.  But the good news is, the game is actually almost done.  I'm a lot happier with the writing now than I was when I last looked at it.  Just need to add finishing touches and the playtest it awhile, then I will release it out of Early Access and into the wild.

In fact, even with this slowdown, I am confident enough that I can get this done Before June that I am setting myself a release date (with preemptive apologies for any delays, of which I currently foresee none):

[spoiler]March 12th, 2025[/spoiler]

[spoiler]And because the game is not as long as I'd hoped back when I started, the price will also permanently decrease to $4.99 like the first Clash game[/spoiler]

Also, barring any setbacks, this will be the last update before the game releases.  See you all then!

notes.title: January Hype Update (Hello, 2025!)
notes.content:
Yet another year down for all of us.  Great job!

This is going to be short because its New Years Day and I've been partaking in the family traditions (hike in a local state park, eat cornbread, watch Star Wars, probably take a nap) and I don't have much time.

If we want to get technical, all the writing for the game is done!  However, the writing kinda sucks right now.  About halfway through January, I'm going to go back to the project with a fresh mind and start revising what I have written to make it actually rather good.  Sometime in early February, I'm going to reassess what I've got.  If I am happy with it, I will add in the last bits of visuals/music/sound and pick a release date.  If I am not, I will revise some more.

So as of today, I can't commit to a specific release date.  But I will give a range of between February and May of this year.  Yes, the writing is that much of a mess right now that I may need to revise up through May.

But enough from me, yall enjoy your New Years Day and any weird traditions you may have.  :-)

notes.title: December Hype Update (Goodbye, 2024!)
notes.content:
I'll make this quick.  :-)

Over November, I technically finished the writing for Chapter 6.  It will need some serious revising because each branch is really short, but still.  It's finished for now.

I'll probably go ahead and write the endings next since I do have a fairly vivid idea of what I want for them.  Then I will sync visuals and music.  Then I will let it all settle for a little bit before revising.  Then Early Access will be done and I will release the VN.  And then I can focus fully on my book, yay!

But now you may be wondering, how long will this take?  When will this freakin' sequel finally be done?  I don't even know anymore, man.  Let's give a vague Summer 2025 and then hope for the best.

Thank you all for sticking around, despite all the challenges and frustrations I have been facing this year both IRL and with this project specifically.  At least I will be going into 2025 with a day job that I love, which in turn gives me more time and energy for devwork.  This year, the problem is going to be a lack of werewithal.  But fortunately for you all, I am amazingly stubborn and refuse to not complete the game.  No EA abandonment will occur (beyond something bizarre like I die or something).

And that's about it for this hype update.  Finished Chapter 6 writing, Chapter 7 writing is next.  Have a lovely holiday season and see you all next year!

notes.title: November Hype Update
notes.content:
So as mentioned, I did take September off to work on a competitive game jam project.  I didn't win anything but I did get better ranking than the last time I joined that specific jam, I got lots of good reviews from those who played my entry, and I got myself somewhat back into gear (if you kind of squint?) and got a good chunk of the Branching Updates paths done.  In fact, this project changed my perspective on visual novel developing altogether.

Mainly that I think Blue Mirage will be my last published visual novel. 

Eagle-eye watchers may have noticed that the promise of bonus stories was removed from the store page.  That is because I can no longer guarantee those bonus stories will be made.  Once Blue Mirage is pushed to 1.0, I want to leave visual novel development behind me.  But I don't want to be one of those devs who leaves stuff abandoned in Early Access.  The main game WILL be finished.  Just can't promise anything after that anymore.  

i'm going to back to Blue Mirage being my main VN project, though!  I want to get the Branching Paths part finished ASAP so that I can go right into the endings.  So the Branching Paths update is now actually going to be the rest of the story, not just the Chapter 6 variations.  Branching Paths will be 1.0, basically.  And it will be here when it gets here.  If I were to give a guesstimate, early 2025.  But don't quote me on that.

But why am I leaving all this behind?  I've been doing visual novel development for four years, why quit now?  

Well, quite frankly, it is because I just want to write.  

And the game I made in September was so fun to write, I kept wanting to play around in that world.  If I'm going to turn anything into a novel, its that game (surprisingly not Clash; Clash works better as a VN than as a book, I've tried).  My jam project that made me decided to switch from VN development to writing is coming to Steam on November 14th.  If you want to help me fund my writing dreams, pick up a copy.  Its cheaper than a cup of coffee!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312820/The_Automaton_of_Second_London

So there you go.  Progress on Blue Mirage has started back up, the Branching Paths update will also be the 1.0 update, I'm semi-shadow dropping a shorter game to help me fund my writing, and Blue Mirage is going to be my last visual novel as I switch from gamedev to writing as my side job hobby thing.

notes.title: September Hype Update
notes.content:
So I have good news and I have bad news.

The good news is, I'm about a month into my new day job (absolutely loving it btw, I haven't been this happy in a day job in years!) and it leaves me with enough time and sometimes even enough energy to do devwork on weekdays.  In theory, this means that Chapter 6 devtime should go a little faster.  And I have gotten a decent amount of progress done on one of the Chapter 6 paths, I suppose.

The bad news is, I'm burnt out.  Fizzled.  Tired of it.  Two years of this and my brain needs a break.

So I am taking that break and working on a different project in September.  Then I'll go back to Blue Mirage in October.  If this test goes well, I'll keep alternating between Blue Mirage and another project monthly to prevent future burnout.

It also means the hype updates are going to slow down (and the crowd went wild).  Doesn't mean I'm dead.  Doesn't mean I'm running away.  Just that I am mixing up my strategy a bit to that I can finish this freakin' thing and be happy with the end result.

(And if you're curious about what I [i]am[/i] working on, keep an eye over on my [url=https://x.com/Sciaenops22]Twitter/X[/url] and/or my [url=https://drone-garden-studios.itch.io/]itch.io[/url].  :-) )

notes.title: The True Negative Update + (Bit Early) August Hype Update
notes.content:
Hurricane Beryl be damned, I got the update finished on time anyway!

The next Early Access update for Clash: Blue Mirage is now available!  The main focus of this update is the addition of Chapter 5, examining the aftermath of what went down in  Chapter 4.  There's also a variety of fixes and revisions that have been introduced.  Take a look at the patch notes:

TRUE NEGATIVE UPDATE PATCH NOTES
[list]
[*] Added Chapter 5 - True Negative!
[*] Added three in-game achievements and one gallery image
[*] Added minor sound effects/voice blurbs at various stages of the game
[*] Minor narrative flow and spelling revisions made to chapters Intro-4
[*] Fixed broken stat changes in Chapter 2
[*] Fixed broken achievement in Chapter 2
[*] Fixed broken Clash sprite in Chapter 3
[*] Fixed Nathan's name displaying as 'Nicole' in Chapter 3 and Chapter 4
[*] Fixed broken stat changes in Chapter 4
[*] Fixed looping investigation glitch in Chapter 4
[/list]

ISSUES STILL PRESENT IN EARLY ACCESS VERSION
[list]
[*] Gallery shows multiples of the same image.  This is a temporary placeholder and will be fixed at the full release!
[*] Scene transitions are not smooth.  This is a known bug and will be worked on for the next update!
[*] Further narrative flow, spelling, sound effect, and musical revisions are needed.  This will be worked on for the next few updates!
[*] Developer turned 34 years old.  Nothing we can do about that.
[/list]
~*~

So what's next?  Well, for one thing, my day job starts up again...but it's a new job and it might be less energy-draining that what I've been doing.  Currently unknown how much it'll effect the dev cycle, but let's all be prepared for Saturday-only devwork again.

But the next update I've already decided is called The Branching Paths Update.  Besides revisions and fixes, this update will add Chapter 6...which is actually more like five chapters.  Each chapter branch reflects the stats you've built up over the game.  There's some key story points that will be the same with each branch, but I still want each one to feel like a different path before they re-converge a little bit for Chapter 7 and the endings.

Speaking of endings, I figured out what they will be (which is more I had earlier this year).  But it's just a matter of getting there.  

So there we are.  We have a new update and the promise of a next update coming whenever it comes.  And I have my birthday to celebrate.  :-)  But don't let my celebration stop you from reporting any glitches or bugs you encounter as you play!  

And I'll see you all for the next round, whenever it may be.

notes.title: Update to that Chapter 5 Release Date...
notes.content:
Sooooo you know that July 30th release date for Chapter 5?
You also know that Hurricane Beryl that blew through Texas and screwed up everything?
Yep.

So this is day three without regular power for me (my mom's bff has power so i can go over there to visit, but that's only in bits and pieces).  No idea when I will get it back, but considering all the downed wires on my street it could be awhile.  I'm also not dealing well with the heat - its 100 degrees outside my house and its 100 degrees inside my house, I have come dangerously come to heat exhaustion several times now.  So with both a lack of power and a lack of health on the line, I now have no idea when I will be able to do regular devwork again.

Best case scenario, I get power back in the next couple of days and am on track.  Current predicted scenario, only Chapter 5 will come out on July 30th; might need to save revisions for a later date.  Worst case scenario, everything gets delayed into August.  Absolutely disgustingly worst case scenario, everything gets delayed into Fall/Winter.

In summary: I hate hurricanes.

notes.title: July Hype Update
notes.content:
I'm tired, I'm overheated from the sun, I'm just gonna keep it simple this month.

[b]Chapter 5 update is going to be released July 30th, whether I like it or not.[/b]

All I need to do is add visuals and sound/music to chapter 5, then revise the game as a whole (and figure out a kickier name for the update than Chapter 5 Update).  So July 30th is a date I am very comfortable with stating.  So I will see you then I guess.

Also, both Clash: Robot Detective and Clash: Blue Mirage are on sale for the Summer Sale.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2222480/Clash_Robot_Detective__Complete_Edition/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2323650/Clash_Blue_Mirage/

notes.title: June Hype Update
notes.content:
Ah, summertime.  When its too hot to go outside and when my day job is put on hold.  I have no excuse NOT to get Chapter 5 at the very least finished.

Which is the plan, of course.  The biggest problem right now is that it's too darn short (and considering I'm a terrible judge of chapter lengths, its saying something if I'm catching it this early on), so not only do I need to finish the chapter but I need to pad it out a little more.  But, if all goes well, maybe late June/early July will see the release of Chapter 5.

Then comes Chapters 6 and 7, and then the two epilogue chapters.  Yes, there's two epilogues.  I don't know why.

Chapter 6 is going to have five branches based on how players have built up their stats throughout the game.  And because I am a mean old lady, your top (maybe top two, if I can figure out how to do so) branch will be available to pick from at the end of Chapter 5.  Replayability???  Look, Digimon Survive did something similar to what I'm planning, if they can pull it off then so can I.  Anyway, I hope to get Chapter 6 started during the summer as well.  More updates on that in the July hype update.

And whenever the Summer sale is, both Robot Detective and Blue Mirage will be in it.

AND in July, I'm going to be prototyping a space game.  Demo will go up once its ready, with the rest of the game coming whenever Blue Mirage is done.

So there you go, all them big news.  Enjoy!

notes.title: May Hype Update
notes.content:
SO.
Uh.
How is everyone?

I do have good news.  I am slowly but surely folding daily devwork back into my schedule.  Of course, the bad news is that - as soon as I do that - MORE stuff gets packed in.  Sometimes I wish I started writing visual novels when I was a college student and had way more free time.  Alas, I took the "famous L4D2 youtuber" route instead (spoiler alert: it did not work out at all...additional spoiler alert: I have just aged myself...)

But the point being, I've been working on Chapter 5.  Still not quite to the level I'd like to be operating at, but getting there.  And with this being May, that means that very soon I will be enjoying a peaceful summer.  Which means my devwork side hustle becomes my devwork main job*!

In even better news, I am very happy with Chapter 5 thus far.  Its a nice breath of fresh, silly air from all the weirdness of Chapter 4.  Hopefully that bit of knowledge will keep us all going until the June Hype Update.

*And this will be reflected by the fact that I will be working on Blue Mirage and on another completely unrelated VN at the same time.  This won't backfire on me at all.

notes.title: April Hype Update
notes.content:
Happy "lying to people is ok so long as it is done for memez and/or lulz" day!  Yes, I have issues with today.

Anyway.

Clash: Blue Mirage has been launched into Early Access.  It's been doing pretty solid so far, and I have you guys to thank for that.  :-)  If you gave it a play, don't forget to leave a review or a comment or a bug report or a whatever.  Those will help me figure out what needs fixing and what ain't broke.

Speaking of fixing, I began work on Chapter 5.  I struggled with Chapter 5 and didn't get very far.  I scrapped what little bit I had for Chapter 5 and started over.  So I can see how this is going to go.  :-/  So stay tuned while I figure out what in the world I am doing.  I have been dabbling in some other projects trying to get back into the daily devwork routine and to get my inspiration kickstarted, so here's hoping it works.

...yes, we're back to boring monthly hype updates for awhile.  At least you know I'm alive and I'm trying.

notes.title: Clash: Blue Mirage is Now Available in Early Access!
notes.content:
It was actually set up to release this morning while I was at work, but then it didn't.  Because lol, I guess?  Still, its all good now; I have released it manually and it is NOW AVAILABLE!

[b]You can play up through Chapter 4 now!  And with a 25% release discount, to boot![/b]

The rest of the game will be released throughout the year and maybe also throughout next year.  Please feel free to mention any glitches you find or story beats you enjoy (or not) in the forums.  I'll be checking them throughout the week and putting together a patch to fix anything I missed.  Just keep in mind that this [i]is[/i] an Early Access game; it's still a work in progress!

Thank you all for hanging in there, and I hope you enjoy the first chunk of the game!

notes.title: March Hype Update - Early Access Release Edition!!!
notes.content:
HOLY CRAP A DEFINITIVE EARLY ACCESS RELEASE DATE!!!!

We've finally gotten here.  To this moment.  Where I can say, without a doubt, that you will get to play this freakin game (the first four chapters, that is).

Let me savor this moment for a bit.

Okay, done.

Clash: Blue Mirage is OFFICIALLY releasing in Early Access on March 8th!

That is next freakin week!!!!!

I ACTUALLY MADE ME DEADLINE!!!!

So I hope you join me next Friday for the EA release, pick up a copy, get involved with the development, help me find bugs, enjoy more Clash, etc etc etc.

notes.title: February Hype Update
notes.content:
I am in the playtesting phase of Blue Mirage's first EA release version.  That's pretty good news.  I'm also super packed this month with only one weekend completely free for said playtesting (and even THAT is looking iffy).  That's pretty not-so-good news.

BUT...I do think I can safely set an idea for when I want to get this game out on EA.  It does mean I've already messed up my own roadmap but still.

If all goes well, Clash: Blue Mirage will release into Early Access on [b]March 8th, 2024![/b]

And in case you're wondering why THAT day in particular, its because I get the whole week following that Friday off to fix whatever is broken that I did not catch in playtesting.  SPRING BREAK!

I hope you're as excited as I am to finally get SOMETHING on the market.  :-)

notes.title: January Hype Update - New Year, New Plans!
notes.content:
[i]wait, is that a NEW PICTURE being used for the announcement headers???  I ACTUALLY MADE SOME PROGRESS on the VISUALS???[/i]

I'm currently putting final touches on Chapter 4.  Then I'm going to test what all I have and make sure it fits together.  Then there's four more chapters planned - and these four chapters are where the branching occurs, so writing-and-development wise its more like ten or twelve more chapters I got to get made.  And as you all know, my day job does not allow me to focus full-time on devwork (unless its weekends and certain holidays or breaks).  Which means this one-year project is looking to be way longer.  And I feel really bad that y'all have to wait on me.

So here is the deal.  Once Chapter 4 is wrapped up and the game is relatively bug-free, [b]I am releasing Chapters 1-4 into Early Access![/b]  You'll get to enjoy the story up through the advertised "Clash gets hacked" part, I'll get help finding any errors (spelling, grammar, or coding) that I missed, and we will all be entertained while I hammer out the rest of the chapters.  :-)

I have an [i]extremely[/i] tentative Early Access release date schedule.  SUPER tentative.  Like, when I actually start hammering out Early Access details I may have to redo this.  So please don't get mad if the schedule changes later on because hey, I warned you:

[list]
[*]Early Access 1 – Chapters 1 through 4 (January or February 2024)
[*]Early Access 2 – adds in Chapter 5 (March 2024)
[*]Early Access 3 – add in all four variations of Chapter 6 (June, July, or August 2024)
[*]Early Access 4 – adds in all four variations of Chapter 7 (September, October, or November 2024)
[*]Full – adds in all four variations of Chapter 8 + two bonus stories + behind the scenes trivia (December 2024, January or February 2025)
[/list]

I guess this also means I can say the full game's release date is early 2025 at maximum.  Providing no catastrophes.  Which also means that it is a good thing I am doing Early Access because hoo boy, that's a ways off for a visual novel.

Thank you all for supporting Clash throughout the years.  When I released the first version of the first game way back in 2021 (has it really already been two and a half years?), I didn't think I'd get ANY sort of response, let alone a positive one.  But I have.  You have no idea how happy it makes me when a piece of fanart shows up in my feed.  When I get my own fridge I'm pinning those arts on it.  The least I can do is give you guys a great sequel in return.  :-)

That's about it from me.  I hope everyone has a wonderful and blessed 20241

notes.title: December Hype Update
notes.content:
So here's the cool thing: over the course of November (specifically, during Thanksgiving break; hooray for weeks off from work!), [b]I finished writing Chapter 4[/b]!  FINALLY.

Now that I've finally got that done, I'm going to go back and touch up everything I have thus far.  I will also add visuals/music/sound to Chapters 3 and 4, because I didn't do that yet.  :-/  Point being, I want to make sure what I have is cohesive and good before I start on the second half of the game.

I will be using all of December for revision purposes.  Then, with the new year, I will start writing Chapter 5.  We are just moving right along!

In fact, I might actually have new screenshots ready for the January hype update!  Wow!

notes.title: November Hype Update
notes.content:
I told you guys last update that I wasn't going to get much done this month.  I was right.  

Essentially all time I would have normally used for devwork went to studying.  Paid off, though; finally have a bachelor's degree and I passed my first certification content exam.  And things are lining out and freeing up some weekend time PLUS I get a week off, so I will be able to make up all the dev time I missed.  Plan is still to finish Chapter 4 and then focus on revisions and touch-ups before moving to the second half of the game.  Plan is also still to release some time in 2024 but I cannot make any guarantees.

Anyway, thank you all for sticking around.  I know its frustrating, all these delays.  So I really am grateful for those of you who haven't given up on me.  I'm trying my best, which is all anyone can do. 

I will say this though; I was able to use my work on both Clash games in my day job.  I've used my experiences writing to help my students learn how to write.  That's been more fulfilling than the actual writing.  :-)

notes.title: October Hype Update
notes.content:
The going was slow at the beginning of September.  At the end of September (and going in to October), it is stopped.  Temporarily.  Don't panic.

I mentioned in the last monthly hype update that I was going to be busy with IRL things to the point of switching to weekend-only work.  I did not realize HOW busy I was going to get.  I have had to cut out a lot of extracurricular activities just to keep up.  And it STILL feels like a struggle some days.

But the good news is, this will soon ease up!  My last college class ends mid to late October.  That is what is eating away at most of my time right now.  Once that is done...well, frankly, I'll still be busy, but its a level of busy that I can handle.  

So now we know that I'm not doing any more devwork until later this month.  The question on your minds I'm sure is "So DID you get anything done?"  Either that or "I wonder what I should eat for breakfast?"  But I can't answer that one.

I finally got the subtitle character into the game!  That's pretty big!  I also wrote out a whole investigation/clue-seeking sequence that plays out like one of my very first games I ever made (if you know about [i]Smart Technology[/i], then wow you've been hanging with me a while).  And, most importantly, the several-chapter-spanning flashback has ended; I got the story caught up with itself.  Not sure if I want to write a story that starts in media res ever again, it was weird.  This was about three Saturdays' worth of work.

Anyway, I hate to be ~that person~ who keeps putting off their devwork but I really need to focus on my college/certification/day job right now.  Once I only have to focus on certification/day job, I will add devwork back in.

Have a great sp00ky month, see you in grateful month!

(And wow, I used a cover image that WASN'T Clash looking over his shoulder at Sal.  What treachery is this???)

notes.title: September Hype Update
notes.content:
August has come and gone, the wee tots are back in school.  And so am I.  This is where the busy-ness has truly settled in.  But possibly the most important busy-ness I have ever found myself in.  Working as a full-time residency teacher, finishing up my bachelor's degree, and starting my certification in special education: this is a huge step in my life that I am excited to take.

There, now you know EXACTLY why [i]Clash: Blue Mirage[/i] is back to weekend-only work.

Well, except for the week I had COVID.  I got devwork done all week there.  But I refuse to talk about my quarantine week because I am still seething that it happened at all.

So what all has gotten done?  I'd say about 40% of Chapter 4!  I've started implementing the "exploring a haunted house looking for clues" angle. For this, I'm harping on [url=https://drone-garden-studios.itch.io/smart-technology]one of my very first games[/url] to create an explorable house and gatherable clues (to be more specific, keys; I genuinely couldn't think of anything else).  I just need to finish this section up before moving back into the narrative.  Said narrative will FINALLY loop back around to the very first scene of the game.  Wow, what a long flashback!  From there, the plan is to have the viewpoint shift to another character for a bit before segueing into Chapter 5.  But before I start on Chapter 5, I'll need to make sure what I have flows well.  All sorts of revising and editing.

It's going to take awhile.  Especially since my day job is, as mentioned before, insanely packed.  But I am a stubborn woman who is bound and determined to finish this game.  It's slow going, but slow going is better than no going.  So stay tuned for more.

OH also this demo did quite well in the Visual Novel Fest.  So thanks to everyone who checked out the demo during that event.  :)

notes.title: Clash: Blue Mirage's demo is in Visual Novel Fest!
notes.content:

But that's not all.  The first game, Clash: Robot Detective, is 50% off in the same event!  This is its lowest discount yet!  [strike]and any money made from the sales of this game will go towards me finally getting my own apartment so uhhhh plz and thank you for purchase[/strike]

I'm excited to be participating in this event, and I hope you are excited to see all the great titles participating!

notes.title: August Hype Update
notes.content:
My goals at the beginning of July were:
[olist]
[*] Finish writing Chapter 3
[*] Finish editing Chapter 3
[*] Write Chapter 4
[*] Finish editing Chapter 4
[/olist]

And you know what, I'll just say it.  Only the first goal got finished.  A lot happened to me IRL during July.  If you follow my social medias or read my Sunday Updates on itchio then you know exactly what I am talking about.  If you don't, then you're fine not knowing the full details; just know that I was very distracted and busy and I ended up getting extremely sick near the end of the month because of what was keeping me so distracted and busy.

BUT...I did finish Chapter 3's writing.  There's still some other little details that need to be done.  Like...visuals.  And sound.  And basically everything else a visual novel needs other than words.  But the writing got done.  AND I started Chapter 4!  This is going to be great, because I'm drawing on one of my earliest games (Smart Technology) to incorporate an investigation scene.  An ACTUAL investigation scene!  IN the DETECTIVE GAME!  WOW!!!!

So what's next for August?  I'll be switching back to weekend-only work at some point after my day job starts back up.  I'll still need to get Chapters 3 & 4 finished up.  From there, I suppose we'll see what happens.

notes.title: July Hype Update
notes.content:
Wow, a lot of dev work can get done when you temporarily don't have a day job getting in the way.

For one thing, [b]Chapter 3 is basically finished[/b].  I have a little bit more writing to do before I move on to the visuals and sound and whatever else needs to be done, but all in all it is so very close to being done.  And that's with the extra work I added for myself.  Namely, Chapter 3's endings.  There are three possible ways you an finish off the chapter, which will affect who will be the main antagonist's henchman for the rest of the game.  It will either be Nathan (the guy from the demo who smashed up the kiosk), Sal (a coffee-brewing robot the same model of the one from the first game's bonus story), and REDACTED (a spoiler character that isn't much of a spoiler if you've been following my Twitter or saw the new main menu but still, I'm trying to hide this one).  

I also redid the art, as mentioned in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2323650/view/3683430269384234926]Statement Of Intent update[/url].  That post still has the link to the essay that explains WHY I changed up the art.  It's also supposed to change in the library but I have not seen that happen yet, I am still fiddling around with that.  I also used this as an excuse to add some screenshots from Chapter 2 to the store page.  I'd have added Chapter 3 screenshots but, as mentioned before, I do not have any just yet because I have not synced the visuals at this time.  Except for the CGs but I didn't want to add those to the screenshots just yet because I said so.  

This also means that [b]there is a different version of the demo now up![/b]  The text content is the same, but the pictures have changed in some spaces (namely Clash's scarf, a couple of backgrounds, and the little kid who shows up).  If you are curious to see the new visuals, give the demo a download and try it out.  [strike]And if the demo doesn't work do let me know because that means I did something wrong on my end.[/strike]

My goals for July are as follows:
[olist]
[*] Get Chapter 3 completely finished
[*] Touch up all the existing work; modify sprite placement, revise sections for clarity, etc
[*] Write Chapter 4 
[*] And hopefully, get visuals and sound synced for Chapter 4
[/olist]

I want to get as much done as I can before my day job starts up again.  It was hard enough balancing IRL work with dev work earlier in the year; I have been told by trustworthy sources that the upcoming year of work is going to be even busier with even less free time.  It's better to get as much stuff done NOW as I can.

notes.title: June Hype Update
notes.content:
I'm just gonna throw it right out to you: I didn't do jack in May.  This sounds awful, I know.  But I have a reason.  It might even count as an excuse!

My day job ended up leeching all of my free time and energy.  And I do mean all of it.  I ended up cutting almost all the extra stuff in my life out just to focus on wrapping it up for the summer break.  But considering how much I like my day job, this is not a bad problem to have.  Unless all you know me for is my devwork.  In which case, it makes me look lazy.  But I promise, the devwork got temporarily cut for the exact opposite of laziness!

But its the summer now, my day job doesn't start back up until August, and I have no summer job lined up.  Which means writing IS going to be my summer job!  I'm doing as much as I can now because I don't know if I'll run into this 'no free time' problem with my day job again in the fall (but I am planning for this).  Plus, I just need something to keep me busy.  I am off to a good start: [b]Chapter 2 is completely finished, and Chapter 3 has begun![/b]

I'm also working on a couple of other projects.  [url=https://drone-garden-studios.itch.io/springtime-at-shoreline]Springtime at Shoreline[/url] is a visual novel about humanoid bettas (that might come to Steam, I'm still debating but so far assuming 'yes'), and [url=https://drone-garden-studios.itch.io/jetti-moray-an-oceanic-fantasy-tale]Jetti Moray[/url] is a fantasy novel about a moray eel saving the world.  As much as I like robots, I like aquatic science even more - so these are fun little projects that tie into my real passion.  I went from no devwork at all to juggling three projects.  Just like the old days.  But if you want to follow those projects, you gotta go to itch.io.  :-(

The July and August updates will hopefully be much more packed than the last couple of monthly hype updates were.  After that, we will see what happens.  Just bear with me pl0x

And unless things change, the Blue Mirage demo may or may not be taking part in the certain festival that occurs in June???  Stay tuned???  Trying to stay subtle about it because, even though I saw other devs making their announcement, I don't actually know if I'm allowed to yet???

notes.title: May Hype Update
notes.content:
Here I am, May 1st, at home sick because my throat hurts so much that i can barely talk.  Thank goodness I can still type!  Here's a quick overview on what went down in April.

I'm going to lead with the bad news: I made the decision in April to switch to weekend-only dev work.  My day job is just too intensive right now to keep up a proper weekly dev work schedule.  This will most likely continue until late May, when my job goes on hiatus.  In fact, it looks like dev work will then become my primary source of income as family circumstances have made it so that I cannot get a summer job.  But we're not here to go into details about my life, we're here to talk Clash.  Still, worth a mention: I've had to severely reduce dev work time, but will greatly increase it at the end of this month.

The good news is, [b]I wrapped up the writing for Chapter 2![/b]  I still need to go back and add the visuals and sound and music, but hey writing is a big chunk of it.  So I am glad that is over.  :-)  Its been a fun chapter, very slice-of-life ish and a bit more humorous before it all goes to heck in Chapter 3.  Plus, any progress is good progress at this point.

So...the May Hype Update is not as long as I had hoped.  But there's still a lot in here.  Hopefully next month's hype update will pick up the tempo a bit more.  We shall see, I suppose.

Oh and before I leave, the first game is on sale 40% off from 5/1 to 5/8, so be sure to pick it up if you haven't already, kthanxbai

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2222480/Clash_Robot_Detective__Complete_Edition/

notes.title: April 2023 Hype Update
notes.content:
I plan to have an update on the first of each month summarizing what happened the month before.  Just to prove that neither I nor the project are dead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43672048/419c756bd245b5cd00571f7eb4d8797a0eff4477.png[/img]

Work on Chapter 2 is underway!  This chapter is more slice-of-life and silly (give people a breather before the main mystery REALLY gets going), as well as setting up different characters and plot threads that will come together at the end.  It involves coffee, secrets, and feeling replaced.  It's been a lot of fun to write, even if I am (I will confess) struggling to find the time and the wherewithal to really get going on it.  The time is a reasonable excuse (I have a day job that's got a lot of work, a college degree that's got a lot of work, extra stuff in the evening that have a lot of work, and a new dog that is a lot of work); the wherewithal is not, so I need to get myself together and get over it.

The part we should really be focusing on though is that Chapter 2 is about halfway done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43672048/818fd0390130567f2f446f02a139870077129186.png[/img]

I also learned something new: how to add a gallery!  I'm still playing around with it; it's probably just going to be one screen with eight images to unlock, rather than several screens with only six images per screen.  I will decide soon enough.  But its cute, its simple, and I like it!  It adds a nice little bit of flair to the project.

I should [i]probably[/i] redo the in-game achievements screen to match the style of the gallery screen, but then again I still really like seeing all the achievement names in a nice and organized list.  Plus, Steam handles the images and pop-ups.  So I think the in-game achievements will stay the same.  We will see.

That's about it for this big April recap/hype update/whatever we want to call it.  Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Clash: Blue Mirage now has a Steam page!
notes.content:
Welcome to the sequel to Clash: Robot Detective: Complete Edition!  Also welcome to the first time I have ever posted a demo to Steam!

So the really sad part is I don't entirely know if I did it right, because Steam has been interacting weirdly with the raw game files (testing the demo causes Steam to record it as Robot Detective hours, downloading the demo here just causes the full game to install, etc).  So if any of you out there run into something weird, please leave a note in the discussions and I will look into it as soon as I can!

Also, Clash: Blue Mirage is still in development.  I have absolutely no idea how long it will be in development.  I want this to be my longest VN yet, with a goal of at least 4-5 hours of story for one playthrough (and more for repeated runs, of course).  That's going to take me awhile.  Especially since I have a day job that will hopefully lead to a rewarding day career.  I have a tentative release date set for May 30th 2024.  Could be finished with the game earlier, could be finished with it later.  No idea.

But hey, that's life.  And I will release it.  I am bound and determined to.

So stay tuned for updates regarding this game!  I plan on doing biweekly updates over on itch.io and then combining them into a monthly update here on Steam.  So that you aren't bombarded with my posts here.  :-)

Enjoy the demo, and again, please leave any comments if anything goes weird for you!
